purpose: Independent check of the Bayesian CPD update (Hirose, TPAMI 2021, Algorithm 1) against a dense NumPy implementation written from the paper, with and without the posterior-variance terms.
fixture: 60 points uniform in [-1,1]^2 x [-0.6,0.6], seed 3, target bent by (0.08 sin 2y, 0, 0.08 cos 1.5x); both rounded to float32 (source.txt, target.txt; copied to tests/data/cpd/bcpd_bend_{source,target}.txt)
parameters: lambda 2, beta 1, 8 iterations, scale estimated, omega 0, kappa infinity, gamma 1, no input normalization

outcomes.without_variance_terms: C++ sigma^2 and scale match the NumPy trace to relative 1e-9 per iteration; sigma^2 falls 0.17 -> 0.055 and the scale moves 0.86 -> 0.79 (no collapse)
outcomes.with_variance_terms: C++ matches to relative 1e-7 per iteration; both implementations collapse the scale (0.47 -> 0.0023 by the eighth iteration) while sigma^2 stays near 0.2
outcomes.reproduction: Both traces regenerate byte-identically from bcpd_reference.py on this host.

not_measured: Scan-scale fixtures, low-rank or subsampled BCPD against NumPy, runtime.
